issue.title: Agent Hijack dependability: make v1 real, then hijack the agent, not the row
issue.description: Pressing ,k (or the kill dialog's h, or `sase agent hijack NAME`) on any local agent row, session container, or session name hijacks the session's occupying turn when that is safe now, latches the hijack to the next safe hand-off when it is not, and otherwise answers with a precise reason and next action, never the generic "not eligible" toast. Ordinary running agent turns, --plan/--tale turns, retries, booting and WAITING/QUEUED turns that hold a numbered workspace, running monitor turns, finalizing turns, staged hand-offs, monitor follow-ups, and executing gates are all covered. A real-pipeline canary proves hijack then Continue works end to end, and concurrent or crashed hijacks converge to exactly one operation and at most one successor.
